notes: New: the Family Dashboard phone app – the dashboard itself on a phone. Every widget is shown full width, one under another, with the screens’ buttons along the bottom; the children’s cards stack the same way. It opens on the calendar (the week, as a list of days when the phone is upright) and turns with the phone. Phones don’t count as screens on your licence.

It replaces the Family Calendar app: houserunner.app/calendar now opens the Family Dashboard app, and you add events from its calendar. Install it from ⚙ Setup → System → Devices and Phones, or Home → Connect a new phone. New icons: Family Admin has a cog, Family Dashboard a green dashboard badge.

The menu: “Advanced” is now “System” (🔧), so the ⚙ cogs only mark the Setup and Widgets groups. Every menu item has a coloured icon – grey until it’s the page you’re on, with white words – and when the window is narrow the menu leaves room for its scroll bar.
